qualifications: Recorded process groups and preservation fields are reported, not independently re-probed by this aggregator.
Index state and numeric file accounting are individually allowlisted; all other project metadata is excluded.
A missing record is distinct from an explicitly null WAL; missing checks never become zero violations or successful preservation.
Health checks describe the preserved snapshot, including an incomplete full index if applicable, not a qualified benchmark completion.
Flow presence, source correctness, full-response truncation, stored-response truncation and Flow truncation are distinct.
The historically wrong Express sendStatus/type/set target must not be credited solely because a Flow is displayed; source review remains separate.
These serial postmeasurement probes are not performance repetitions or agent A/B. No macros or corpus builds run in this aggregator.
Severity totals cover all file diagnostics only when the explicit completeness flag is true; otherwise they describe stored examples only.

All 27 new xmonad/Express responses have no recorded tool error, whole-output truncation, stored-response truncation or Flow-excerpt truncation. Express sendStatus/type/set remains a known wrong target and is not credited.

The selected GHC-full snapshot remains indexing after the 1800-second benchmark timeout: its three observed postmeasurement Flows do not make it a qualified completed benchmark. The first two whole outputs are truncated; all three stored responses and Flow excerpts are untruncated.

The complete stored file diagnostic enumeration records 20 warnings/zero errors for GHC core, and 44 warnings/two parser-timeout errors for GHC full. Storage integrity is distinct from extraction completeness and semantic correctness.
Baseline-full diagnostics are explicitly reused from earlier on 20 September. No baseline re-execution is represented by the nine new probes.

health.pageStorageMeaning: Logical committed pages including copied WAL; not a compacted database size. No checkpoint or VACUUM performed by the recorded diagnostics.
health.orphanInterpretation: No missing edge/reference node endpoints observed. Files without nodes are reported separately and do not alone prove graph corruption.

fileDiagnostics.filesWithErrorsMeaning: File records carrying diagnostics, including warnings; not a count of fatal file extraction errors.
